# Writing Tool & Design Blocks Requirements Checklist: F119 E-Blast Two-Sided Approval

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements that describe the upgraded writing tool — toolbar, design blocks, images, preview, brand settings and templates (US3, FR-037..046a) — are they complete, unambiguous, consistent and measurable?

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [exploration-2026-09-18.md](../exploration-2026-09-18.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. ## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact list of formatting the tool must offer closed (headings — which levels?, quote, divider, lists, bold, underline, links, image, button, banner) so that "every kind of content the platform keeps" cannot drift? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038, §US3-AS1] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): heading levels offered by the toolbar not fixed (sanitiser keeps h1–h4)
- [x] CHK002 Is the behaviour for content the platform does NOT keep specified on both entry paths — typed shortcut AND paste — including what the user sees when it is refused? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): what the user sees when a pasted/typed unsupported element is refused is not stated
- [x] CHK003 Are the call-to-action button's inputs and limits defined (text length, allowed link schemes, one per message or many)? [Gap, Spec §FR-041] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): CTA text length, allowed link schemes, and count per message not defined
- [x] CHK004 Are the banner's inputs and limits defined (image constraints, required description, position — top only or anywhere)? [Gap, Spec §FR-041] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): banner constraints (size, position, required description) not defined
- [x] CHK005 Is the "faithful preview" requirement complete for both surfaces — the inline pane and the dialog — including what the phone width is and what the empty state says? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043, §US3-AS6/AS7] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): phone preview width and empty-state wording not specified
- [x] CHK006 Are the test-copy requirements complete: who receives it, how it is marked, whether it renders design blocks and the brand header, and any rate limit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): test copy: rendering of blocks/brand header and any rate limit not stated
- [x] CHK007 Is the link dialog's required capability ("links with editable link text") specified together with what happens to an invalid or disallowed link? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): behaviour on an invalid / disallowed link in the link dialog not stated
- [x] CHK008 Are brand-settings requirements complete — where the page lives, who may view it (marketing has no settings permission), what the contrast rule compares against, and the address format? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041b, §Edge Cases "no logo on file"] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): Brand page location, who may VIEW it (marketing has no settings permission), address format not stated

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "the chamber's brand colours" reduced to exactly one colour everywhere it is mentioned (US3-AS4 says "colours", FR-041b says "exactly one primary colour")? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3-AS4 vs §FR-041b] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): US3-AS4 says "brand colours" (plural) vs FR-041b "exactly one primary colour"
- [x] CHK010 Is "degrade to readable plain content" defined per block (button → link with the same text? banner → image with its description?) so it can be tested? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is "identically in the preview and in the delivered email" defined at the element level rather than visually, matching SC-011's automated comparison? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042, §SC-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is "the same tool" (FR-039) defined as identical controls, or identical capabilities with screen-specific exceptions (e.g. templates cannot upload E-Blast-tied images)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, §FR-046a]
- [x] CHK013 Is "short text description" for images bounded (min/max length) and is its language expectation stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040] — gap closed 2026-09-18 in spec.md (*checklist default*): alt-text length bounds not defined

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do FR-040 (image tied to the E-Blast) and FR-046a (image tied to the template, carried by reference) agree on what happens when a member edits a template-derived image in their draft? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, §FR-046a]
- [x] CHK016 Does the 200 KB body limit and 5 MB image limit inherited from F7 still hold with design blocks, and does the spec say so? - [x] CHK017 Is the "no italic when the interface language is Thai" rule consistent with a Thai user writing an English E-Blast (is that trade-off acknowledged)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-044]

- [x] CHK020 Is US3-AS1's "nothing the platform would later strip can be produced by a keyboard shortcut" testable as a finite list of shortcuts? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AS1]
